newsitem.title: CHILE: Delayed GasAndes scheme expects reports this week.
newsitem.headline: Delayed GasAndes scheme expects reports this week.

text.p: The GasAndes natural gas pipeline scheme expects technical reports to be ready this week on its plans for mud and rockslide prevention at a section of the project in a valley near Santiago, said a spokesman.

GasAndes was forbidden by a court order last week from pumping natural gas through Chile after complaints by residents that barriers to protect the pipeline would not be ready by the end of the month when the project was due to be completed.
"We expect technical studies this week from (state environment agency) Conama and the electricity and fuel superintendency on the project," said the spokesman.
The studies are among a batch of technical reports ordered by the court in the injunction which has halted temporarily the company's plans to carry out flow tests on the duct.

The pipeline will pump natural gas several hundred kilometers over the Andes from Mendoza in northern Argentina to Chile. It is owned by a consortium headed by Canada's NOVA Corp and Chilean power utility Chilgener.
Building work on the rest of the project will go ahead while the court studies the reports, he said.
